backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods or state.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature-removal evidence mapping features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten one‑sentence summaries for each frontend file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables defining light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/anniversary/content.ts: Central configuration defining all anniversary text, timeline data, messages, and optional video settings.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component wiring all homepage sections with scroll‑spy navigation and optional video section.
frontend/src/components/AboutNoteSection: Renders the about section using Hindi content from configuration.
frontend/src/components/AnniversaryNavba: Scrolling‑aware nav bar with Hindi labels and mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/ClosingBlessingS: Displays the closing blessing quote and attribution inside a styled card.
frontend/src/components/DecorativeDivide: Shows a centered ornamental divider image using SafeImage.
frontend/src/components/FramedPhoto.tsx: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/GallerySection.t: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the hero section using anniversary content with names, year, and welcome note.
Renders a stats grid showing computed anniversary metrics like years, months, days, and memories.
Shows a list of anniversary messages with author attribution in styled cards.
frontend/src/components/PatternBackgroun: Applies a fixed repeating background pattern behind the entire page.
frontend/src/components/SafeImage.tsx: Image component that resolves asset URLs and shows a fallback UI when loading fails.
Displays a vertical alternating timeline of milestone events from anniversary content.
frontend/src/components/VideoMontageSect: Shows a video section using either a local video file or external embed based on configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, logout, state, and saved identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, and component utility classes for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider and mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/utils/assetUrl.ts: Generates correct asset URLs respecting the app's base path for static file loading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s configuration for a traditional Hindi anniversary website, specifying required themes, content rules, and removed features. Lists architectural notes and existing features, including timeline and theme requirements, while marking music and photo features for omission.
